transcript.text: I'd like to begin with my report as the participating teacher. In my classroom trial with all 9th-grade sections, I recorded 23 phone-related interruptions in two weeks using open bins. However, when I tested numbered locking pouches, they significantly reduced interruptions. Based on those findings, I recommended in my team notes that we run a grade-9-only pilot using one pouch per student. I should note that those team notes have not yet been added to the draft proposal.
